title: Add action handler examples, modal cross-reference validation, and action.mdx doc sync
body:
Follow-up to #833: fills three gaps — dangling handler references in examples, stale docs, and missing modal target validation.

### Modal cross-reference validation (`stack.zod.ts`)

- `validateCrossReferences()` now checks `action.type="modal"` targets against the `pages[]` collection, mirroring the existing `flow` → `flows[]` pattern
- Skips when `pageNames.size === 0` (plugin may provide them)

```typescript
// Validate modal-type actions reference a defined page
if (action.type === 'modal' && action.target && pageNames.size > 0 && !pageNames.has(action.target)) {
  errors.push(
    `Action '${action.name}' references page '${action.target}' (via modal target) which is not defined in pages.`,
  );
}
```

### Example handler implementations (18/18 actions covered)

Complete handler coverage across both example apps with full registration lifecycle:

- **app-todo** (8/8 actions): `task.handlers.ts` — 6 script handlers (`completeTask`, `startTask`, `cloneTask`, `massCompleteTasks`, `deleteCompletedTasks`, `exportTasksToCSV`) + 2 modal handlers (`deferTask`, `setReminder`)
- **app-crm** (10/10 actions): `handlers/` directory with lead (`convertLead`, `addToCampaign`), opportunity (`cloneRecord`, `massUpdateStage`), case (`escalateCase`, `closeCase`), contact (`markAsPrimaryContact`, `sendEmail`), and global (`exportToCSV`, `logCall`) handlers
- **`register-handlers.ts`** for both apps — demonstrates the full `engine.registerAction()` registration lifecycle with architecture diagrams showing metadata → handler → registration flow
- **`objectstack.config.ts`** updated in both apps with `onEnable` lifecycle hook that wires handler registration at runtime
- Action barrels (`index.ts`) export metadata definitions only (safe for `Object.values()` → `defineStack()`); handlers are in separate paths

### Documentation (`action.mdx`)

- `execute` field marked **deprecated** with migration callout
- Added target binding rules table (required vs optional per action type)
- Added cross-reference validation section
- Added platform comparison table (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Power Platform)

### Tests

- 3 new tests: detect undefined page, pass with defined page, skip when no pages defined
- Full suite: 6557/6557 passing
